run_actionengine_serve: run the actionengine serve command to start a WebRTC server with an action registry
serve_action_registry: serve an action registry module as a WebRTC server with API key authentication and timed tokens
setup_action_engine_settings: setup action engine global settings to enable auto-deserialize, read order, and remove read chunks
create_host_and_timed_token: create a new scoped host and timed token via the actionengine API when no active token exists
parse_cli_args: parse command line arguments for the actionengine serve command including api key, host, and registry path
